keywords: EF 上线后量子安全网站 pq.ethereum.org

summary: EF 多个团队上线 pq.ethereum.org，汇集以太坊后量子安全工作的概览、路线图、资源与 FAQ，从 2018 年基于 STARK 的签名聚合研究发展到多团队协作。RogerPodacter 再次更新 EIP-8182，提交并合并。CarlBeek 开设 EIP-8198 Quick Slots 讨论帖。EIP-8141 frame 交易第二次专场议程发布，主题是交易池策略。

keywords_en: EF launches the post-quantum site pq.ethereum.org
EIP-8045 extended to exclude slashed validators from all duties
summary_en: Several EF teams launched pq.ethereum.org with an overview, roadmap, resources and FAQ for Ethereum's post-quantum effort, which grew from STARK based signature aggregation research in 2018 into a multi team project. RogerPodacter updated EIP-8182 again, submitted and merged. CarlBeek opened the EIP-8198 Quick Slots thread. The agenda for the second EIP-8141 frame transaction breakout was posted, focused on transaction pool strategy.
